scope: Mayor Deb archive, Regulars and Town Regular handoff
Town Hall feedback intake and civic-records lifecycle
privacy, abuse, failure and accountability boundaries
known_blockers: The public comment-card controller is explicitly release-held; no live Supabase insert, deployed RLS, public-origin or staff-workflow test was authorised in this repair cycle.
The browser receipt and device-local timestamp confirm only a synthetic accepted response locally, not staff review, reading, resolution or durable return state.
No operational evidence was found for rate limiting, CAPTCHA, spam/abuse review, incident ownership, retention, staff notification or response SLA.
A server-side intake boundary with validation, anti-automation, idempotency or safe ambiguous-outcome handling and controlled logging remains required before launch promotion.
The schema contains disposition fields, but no inspected client or operating record proves who can triage them or how a writer receives an accountable outcome.
Plausible and Clarity are installed, but no Town Hall privacy-safe event contract, aggregate pull, baseline or review cadence is wired.
The requested crisp straight-on operable-lobby art direction remains an owner decision; fresh captures verify mechanics, not visual approval.
